blocks.text: With a comfortable contoured seat and waterfall front, the POLYWOOD® Modern Adirondack Chair (AD420) offers a modern take on a traditional classic. Made in Syracuse, Indiana from durable, eco-friendly POLYWOOD lumber, the Modern Adirondack Chair will not rot, peel, or splinter like natural wood, and requires only minimal maintenance for years of stain-resistant outdoor use. POLYWOOD lumber is infused with UV protectant coloring throughout, so there’s no exterior finish to wear away: simply wash with soapy water and a soft bristle brush to maintain the appearance of painted natural wood. peeling, chipping, rotting, and cracking. The Modern Adirondack Chair weighs only 34 lbs, and measures 29.25x34,68x32.13 inches with seat dimensions of 20.5x17.37x13.68 inches.

items.label: ALL-WEATHER PERFORMANCE
items.value: Constructed from Genuine POLYWOOD infinitely recyclable lumber, ClimateTuff durable material that stands up to moisture and temperature extremes and isn't prone to cracking, peeling, or chipping. Perfect for a firepit.

items.label: ERGONOMIC COMFORT DESIGN
items.value: A contoured seat with a waterfall front enhances comfort and support. Wide armrests and a relaxed back angle encourage extended outdoor lounging with your POLYWOOD adirondack chair. This is no ordinary plastic adirondack.

items.label: LASTING COLOR, LOW-MAINTENANCE FINISH
items.value: ColorStay technology integrates UV inhibitors into the HDPE composite lumber for lasting color retention. Cleans easily with soap and water. No painting, staining, or sealing required for these firepit chairs.

items.label: SECURE ASSEMBLY WITH MARINE-GRADE HARDWARE
items.value: Includes clear instructions and ClimateTuff hardware made with the best 18/8 marine-grade quality stainless steel hardware for corrosion resistance and long-term stability.

items.label: MADE IN THE USA WITH PRACTICAL DIMENSIONS
items.value: Measures 32"D x 29.25"W x 34"H and features clean, modern lines that complement patios, decks, porches, poolside spaces, and fire pit seating areas. Available as a black adirondack and many other colors.

items.label: Included Components
items.value: 1 Adirondack Chair + Product & Assembly Guide, + Hardware

items.label: Item Dimensions D X W X H
Product Care Instructions
items.value: For a quick and easy cleaning, use a clean cloth to wipe down each piece with soap and water.

items.label: Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: The product requires assembly. Clear instructions and marine-grade quality hardware are included for easy assembly.
